prompt: A creature sprite for RimWorld: the yanker, an invented alien corridor predator. A long, low ambush hunter built for a tunnel: it lies dormant in a flat, sprawling coil, two low overlapping loops spread side by side, wedged into one narrow gap, and it wakes only when prey comes within touching distance. The coil is a broad flat mound about 340 px wide and about 150 px tall, roughly 2.3 times wider than tall, with a wide base and a gently rounded crown. Its width, thickness and bulk are identical in every facing: the two loops spread to the same left and right extent, 340 px across, in the front, side and rear views. The plated segments wrap visibly around the pile and run on into one another, so a single long, low, continuous serpentine body is legible. Anatomy: a heavy blunt wedge of a head with a wide hinged mouth ringed by thick pouchy lip-flaps and short hooked grasping palps at the jaw corners, small recessed eyes under bony brow ridges. The head is held close to the ground, resting low on the front edge of the coil with the jaw near the floor line. The long limbless body is built from broad overlapping armoured plates like a segmented carapace, dark mottled leathery hide with pale rubbery seams and a velvety sheen, and a ridge of short gripping spurs along each flank that brace against corridor walls. One continuous body with exactly one head end and one tail end. The tail ends in a single thick blunt anchoring paddle with a cluster of hooked grip-spurs, trailing from the lower rear of the coil. Colour: deep olive-brown hide, pale rubbery seams, darker plates. Front view (south), eyes toward the viewer: the low head rests at the front of the broad flat coil, and the tail paddle is tucked behind the coil with only its tip showing at lower centre. Side view (east), profile: the low head at the front of the coil with the spur ridge visible along the flank, and the single tail paddle trailing from the rear lower left. Rear view (north), seen from behind: the plated back and spur ridge face the viewer as the same broad flat mound, 340 px wide, with one full-width loop on the left and one full-width loop on the right reaching the same outer edges as in the front view, the same body bulk at every tier, the same low rounded crown about 150 px tall, and the same rounded outline as the front view; the head is hidden behind the coil and the single tail paddle sits centred at the bottom of the coil, toward the viewer. Realistic painterly vanilla RimWorld sprite style, soft painted edges; value and colour contrast against the ground carry the silhouette. Exactly ONE creature, centred, the whole body visible with nothing cut off. Fully transparent background: no ground, no water, no shadow, no text, no border.
